summary.text: Christian Maxwell, a Republican business consultant and entrepreneur, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Illinois's 1st District to Jonathan Jackson.
She describes herself as a mother and entrepreneur, and she defeated Marcus Lewis in the March 17, 2026 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: Maxwell was born in Belleville, Illinois, and graduated from Belleville Township East High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Illinois Chicago in 2012.
Her career experience includes working as a business consultant, according to Ballotpedia, and she describes her career as building businesses and leading grassroots community initiatives.
Maxwell won the Republican nomination for U.S. House in Illinois' 1st District on March 17, 2026, defeating Marcus Lewis.
She describes herself as a conservative candidate grounded in faith, family and community, and Ballotpedia lists her religion as nondenominational Christian.
She received 28.3% of the vote to Jonathan Jackson's 71.7%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
